def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    # The source motif is the contiguous 3-cell vertical run of 5s; its center is the placement anchor.
    for r,c in markers:
        for dr in (-1,0,1):
            rr=r+dr
            if 0<=rr<len(out): out[rr][c]=5
    return out
